title: Cantor Hall, The Chickenshit Report, & The Night the Keycards Got Shuffled
description: From Sunday check-in at Cantor Hall with a leering roommate, edible-in-name-only cafeteria rations, and the dreaded 11:00 PM gender-visitation curfew to a violent afternoon in the therapeutic pool, a bureaucracy that writes Nate up on the 'Chickenshit Report' for shielding his sister's chest while her hands hold a bleeding nose, and a late-night dorm database mix-up that puts Katie and Natalie in danger.
